Name: Ryomen Sukuna NPC - Jujutsu Kaisen
Author: yujihat
Description:
[b][size=4][u]Brief Overview[/u]

[/size][/b][size=2]Sukuna is a very rude and very threatening NPC mod. He is NOT NICE. You can date him and you can marry him, but he only has around 5-10 actually nice lines about the player. Please please keep this in mind. He is still the King of Curses, he is still a giant A-hole.

This is my first ever mod so please let me know if there's anything wrong with the files!

[b]He is compatible with the Gojo mod by cursedcure!! I have not tested him with any other NPCs yet!!![/b]

[/size][u][size=4][b]Gift Likes/Dislikes[/b][/size][/u][size=2]

[b]Loves[/b]: Tea Leaves, Green Tea, Sashimi, Tuna, Ancient Fruit, Peach.

[b]Likes[/b]: Milk, L Milk, Carp, Ruby

[b]Dislikes[/b]: Dessert items.

[b]Hates[/b]: Hot Pepper, Spicy Eel, Trash, and just about everything else.

[/size][size=4][b][u]Schedule
[/u][/b][/size][size=2]
Monday, Wednesday

0610 He starts at the Wizard Tower
1200 He will leave for the beach, he gets there around 1500.
1900 He leaves the beach to go to the lakeside.
2200 He goes back into the Wizard Tower.

Tuesday, Friday

0610 He starts at the Wizard Tower
1200 Leaves to go to the Museum, gets there around 1600.
1900 Leaves to go to the lakeside.
2200 Goes back into the Wizard Tower.

Thursday, Saturday, Sunday

0610 He starts at the Wizard Tower.
1200 Leaves to go to the lakeside.
2200 Goes back into Wizard Tower.

[/size][size=4][b]Heart Events

[/b][/size][size=2]Yay he finally has heart events! Here is how to trigger them <3

[b][u]Two Heart Event [/u]

[/b]On Thursday, Saturday or Sunday between 1200 and 1900, head to the Forest.

[b][u]Four Heart Event [/u]

[/b]On a Thursday, Saturday or Sunday between 1300 and 1900, head to the Forest. (This is a separate event from the two heart event, don't worry :) )

[b][u]Six Heart Event [/u]

[/b]On a Monday or Wednesday between 1500 and 1700, head to the Beach.

[b][u]Eight Heart Event [/u]

[/b]Not yet coded.

[b][u]Ten Heart Event [/u]

[/b]On any day, leave your house between the hours of 0600 and 2500, he will be there waiting for you :)

[/size][size=2][size=2][b][u]Future Additions

[/u][/b]I do plan on adding the following;

[*][size=2]Movie Theater interactions and preferences [/size]
[*][size=2]Ginger Island (He has special dialogue now but no bathing suit sprites right now :))
[/size]
[*][size=2][s]Child pack to make his kids look more like him. [/s][b]DONE
[/b][/size]
[*][size=2]Definitely his 8 heart event
[/size]
[*][size=2]Possibly a 14 heart event :) [/size]
[/list][size=2]
